speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss, along with an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. Can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you've noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: The fatigue and abdominal pain have been bothering me for about four weeks, and I've lost roughly 12 pounds during that time. I haven't noticed any changes in my bowel habits, but I do feel an unusual fullness in my belly that makes my clothes feel tight. speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rapid weight loss, abdominal fullness, and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, I am highly suspicious of an underlying malignancy, likely gastrointestinal or lymphatic in origin. DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastrointestinal Malignancy with Metastasis
